title: Inventory and Postcards
author: August Amberdale
blurb: Astrid Whitlock, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
